title: Needs attention
summary: The problems that need a person: a heading with their count, then each problem with its status, title, a line of text and one action (a link or a button), the most serious first. With no problems it draws nothing, or one quiet line; it never takes an empty card.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: The heading; «Требует внимания» / «Needs attention» in the page language when not set. The count of items stands beside it

heading-level.description: The level of the heading in the page's outline

empty.description: With no items: none draws nothing at all (the host takes no room); line draws one quiet line, empty-text with a check

empty-text.description: The quiet line of empty line; «Всё в порядке» / «All is well» when not set

size.description: The ladder rung: the heading and titles are the rung's line, the texts the rung below's, a one-line row the rung's control height. 1/2 for a side panel

items.description: The problems that need a person, each {id, status error|warning|info|success, title, text?, action?: {label, href} or {label, event}}. A property, or the JSON island a server prints; the host sets the whole list again when a problem appears or ends. The list orders them by severity (error, warning, info, success), the host's order inside a status. An item without an id or a title is left out; another status reads as info

sf-list-attention-navigate.summary: A person pressed an item's action link (vocabulary §5 navigate {id, href}). A request: a page cancels it to go there itself (a router); not cancelled, the browser follows href. A press with a modifier key or a middle button opens the link elsewhere and asks nothing

sf-list-attention-apply.summary: A person pressed an item's action button, one without href (vocabulary §5 apply {action, scope: entry, ids}): action is the item's action.event, ids the item's id. The host does it (restarts a job, opens a dialog) and sets the list again

forbidden_client_responsibilities: finding the problems (the host checks and sets the list)
deciding when a problem ends (the host sets the list again)
doing an action (the host answers apply or navigate)

keyboard: Tab reaches each item's action in order; Enter follows a link, Enter or Space presses a button

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-list-attention on an overview screen for the problems that need a person now: server health, site checks, import errors, update readiness, a form's validation summary.
do_not: Do not wrap it in a card that stays when the list is empty; with empty none it takes no room
Do not use it for news or a history; sf-list-feed or a timeline does that
Do not use it for a page-wide condition above the header; sf-alert-bar does that
